en: Basic Law (constitution): fundamental rights, federal structure, state organs, legislation, judiciary
Federal Constitutional Court Act: constitutional complaints, procedure before the BVerfG
Civil Code: contracts, obligations, torts, property, family law, inheritance, tenancy, sales, consumer protection
Introductory Act to the Civil Code: private international law (which country's law applies), transitional rules, consumer information duties
Product Liability Act: strict liability of manufacturers for defective products
General Equal Treatment Act: anti-discrimination in employment and civil contracts
Condominium Act: ownership of apartments, owners' associations, management
Insurance Contract Act: rights and duties of insurers and policyholders
Commercial Code: merchants, commercial register, commercial partnerships (OHG, KG), accounting, commercial transactions
Limited Liability Companies Act: founding, managing directors, shareholders, liability of a GmbH
Stock Corporation Act: AG founding, management board, supervisory board, shareholders' meeting, corporate groups
Transformation Act: mergers, splits, change of legal form of companies
Insolvency Code: insolvency proceedings, creditors, administrator, consumer insolvency, discharge of residual debt
Unfair Competition Act: misleading advertising, aggressive practices, cease-and-desist claims
Act against Restraints of Competition: antitrust, cartels, abuse of dominance, merger control, public procurement
Copyright Act: protected works, author rights, licences, limitations, enforcement
Trade Mark Act: registration, protection and infringement of trade marks
Patent Act: patentability, application, patent infringement
Protection Against Dismissal Act: when a dismissal is socially unjustified, lawsuits against dismissal
Works Constitution Act: works councils, co-determination in the workplace
Working Hours Act: maximum working hours, breaks, rest periods, Sunday work
Federal Leave Act: minimum paid vacation for employees
Part-Time and Fixed-Term Employment Act: part-time rights, limits on fixed-term contracts
Minimum Wage Act: statutory minimum wage
Continued Remuneration Act: pay during sickness and public holidays
Maternity Protection Act: protection of pregnant and breastfeeding employees
Vocational Training Act: apprenticeships (Ausbildung), training contracts, exams
Labour Court Act: procedure before the labour courts
Collective Agreements Act: binding effect of collective bargaining agreements
Temporary Employment Act: agency work, equal pay for temp workers
Occupational Safety and Health Act: employer duties for safety at work
Criminal Code: general principles of criminal liability, sentencing, and all offences (theft, fraud, assault, homicide, etc.)
Code of Criminal Procedure: investigation, arrest, pre-trial detention, trial, appeals, rights of the accused
Regulatory Offences Act: fines (Bußgeld) for administrative offences, procedure
Narcotics Act: controlled substances and drug offences
Weapons Act: possession, licences and prohibitions for weapons
Code of Civil Procedure: civil lawsuits, evidence, judgments, appeals, enforcement (Zwangsvollstreckung), default proceedings (Mahnverfahren)
Act on Proceedings in Family Matters: divorce, custody, maintenance proceedings, guardianship, probate, registers
Courts Constitution Act: court system, jurisdiction of Amtsgericht, Landgericht, OLG, BGH
Forced Sale Act: foreclosure auctions and receivership of real property
Court Fees Act: court costs and fee tables
Lawyers' Remuneration Act: statutory lawyer fees
Administrative Procedure Act: administrative acts, hearings, revocation, public-law contracts
Code of Administrative Court Procedure: lawsuits against authorities, interim relief
Trade Regulation Act: starting a business (Gewerbeanmeldung), licences, prohibitions
Freedom of Information Act: access to federal government information
Federal Data Protection Act: national supplement to the GDPR, employee data, data protection officers
Telecommunications-Telemedia Data Protection Act: cookies, confidentiality of communications
Digital Services Act (replaced the Telemedia Act TMG in 2024): provider information (Impressum), liability of hosting providers, national enforcement of the EU Digital Services Act
Residence Act: visas, residence permits, Blue Card, settlement permit, family reunification, deportation
Nationality Act: acquiring and losing German citizenship, naturalisation requirements
Asylum Act: asylum procedure, refugee status, subsidiary protection
Social Code I: general principles of social benefits, rights and duties of claimants
Social Code II: basic income support for jobseekers (Bürgergeld / formerly Hartz IV)
Social Code III: unemployment insurance, unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld I), job promotion
Social Code IV: common rules of social insurance, contributions, employment status
Social Code V: statutory health insurance, insured persons, benefits, contributions
Social Code VI: statutory pension insurance, retirement age, pension calculation
Social Code VII: statutory accident insurance, work accidents, occupational diseases
Social Code VIII: child and youth welfare, daycare, Jugendamt
Social Code IX: rehabilitation and participation of people with disabilities
Social Code X: administrative procedure of social agencies, social data protection
Social Code XI: long-term care insurance, care levels (Pflegegrade)
Social Code XII: social assistance, basic income in old age and reduced earning capacity
Housing Benefit Act: rent subsidies (Wohngeld)
Federal Training Assistance Act: student financial aid (BAföG)
Fiscal Code: general tax procedure, tax assessment, deadlines, objections, tax evasion
Income Tax Act: taxable income, deductions, tax classes, wage tax, capital gains
Corporate Income Tax Act: taxation of corporations
Trade Tax Act: municipal trade tax on businesses
Value Added Tax Act: VAT rates, exemptions, invoices, small business rule
Inheritance and Gift Tax Act: tax on inheritances and gifts, allowances
Real Estate Transfer Tax Act: tax on buying real property
Code of Procedure for Fiscal Courts: lawsuits against tax authorities
Road Traffic Act: driving licences, liability of vehicle owners, points system, driving bans
Road Traffic Regulations: rules of the road, speed limits, signs, parking
Driving Licence Regulation: licence classes, probation, medical-psychological assessment (MPU)
Land Register Code: land register entries, priority, procedure
Notarisation Act: notarial deeds and procedure
Civil Status Act: birth, marriage and death registration
Civil Partnership Act: registered same-sex partnerships (pre-2017)
Pension Rights Adjustment Act: splitting pension rights on divorce
